decisions.reason: In 2024 the firm gave the condenser its own page, a visible and growing commitment to a product close to its core offer, so management will persist with it.
This second condenser was also raised to a dedicated page in 2024, which signals public commitment and fits the firm's efficiency direction, so dropping it would be hard to justify.
The tube liner supports the firm's lifecycle service strategy and costs little to keep; any weak demand can be put down to the service sales cycle.
Customized air coolers are central to the firm's claim of integrated solutions, so it stays despite only a modest presence on the website.
Tube end repair inserts extend the service and spare parts business the firm has invested in, so management keeps them while slow uptake can still be seen as temporary.
